channel.title: Comments on: Text: pedagogy of attunement

item.title: By: injairu
item.dc:creator: injairu
item.description: I am literary buzzing from this piece. Ive been trying to finish a doctorate that speaks of pedagogies of attunement and the resonance is just bewildering i feel like here I have encountered a sister sense which already is languaging itself in ways I have been gesturing and grappling towards. This is an indelible resource on many levels. Thank you
